original.verbatim:
Certainly! Here's a revised version of your love story that is more focused on your application for an open work permit:

I first met my wife while working at Skyworth Digital in 2018. She had been with the company for over five years, and we happened to work in the same department. Although I was drawn to her grace and poise, I didn't act on my feelings while we worked together.

After I left the company in October 2019, I eventually summoned up the courage to ask her out. We spent time together, sharing our interests and exploring new places. Over time, our friendship deepened into love.

In June 2021, my wife moved in with me, and we continued to build our life together. When she decided to pursue further studies in Canada, I applied for an open work permit to accompany her. Our love and commitment to each other has only grown stronger since we embarked on this journey together.

As we look back on the moments that led us to where we are now, we are convinced that our love is forever. I will always cherish the memories of the sunset on the beach where I first confessed my love to her, and the sunrise over the sea when she agreed to be my wife.

Sure, here is a revised version:

I am writing to apply for an open work permit to accompany my wife during her studies in Canada. I first met my wife when we both worked for Skyworth Digital in 2018. She had been with the company for over five years, and we happened to work in the same department. Although I was drawn to her grace and poise, I didn't act on my feelings while we worked together.

After I left the company in October 2019, I finally mustered the courage to ask her out. Our courtship was filled with shared memories such as traveling to different places, enjoying movies, and playing badminton. I remember the unparalleled feeling of joy every time we got to spend time together, and I knew that I was meant to be with her.

I knew that life with her would be a cherished experience, and when she moved in with me in June 2021, I felt complete. We have been living together ever since, and our journey in life together has resulted in our decision to get married in November 2022. Our love only grows stronger, and I am convinced that my future is in Canada with my wife. I sincerely hope that my application will be granted, so I can continue to support my beloved wife in her academic pursuits.
